description: Net LHV efficiency as f(PLR, T_amb) with Rankine cycle basis; coal mass flow and CO2 emission rate derived from efficiency.

unit.name: Generic 500 MW Subcritical PC Plant (540 C / 160 bar)
unit.source: Booras, G. & Holt, N. (2004). Pulverized coal and IGCC plant cost and performance estimates. Gasification Technologies Conference. EPRI; IEA CCC/168 (2010).

eta_iso.note: Net LHV efficiency at rated load (PLR=1, T_amb=15C); typical subcritical 35-38%

k_amb.note: Efficiency derating per K; condenser back-pressure effect (~0.03%/K)

LHV_coal.note: Bituminous coal lower heating value; range 23-29 MJ/kg

coal_carbon_fraction.note: Mass fraction of carbon in coal (bituminous)
